text.en:
Laws shall take effect after fifteen days
following the completion of their publication either in
the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circu-
lation in the Philippines, unless it is otherwise provided.

Article 2 of Republic Act No. 386, otherwise
known as the "Civil Code of the Philippines," and all
other laws inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

27
SeC. 3. This Executive Order Shall take effect imme-
diately after its publication in the Official Gazette.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-
braym b Aquint
By the President:
